about: The Workbench icons of the HostileTakeover drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/hostiletakeover.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: a desert tank under a radar dish) is The AmiCradle Team's own, BSD-2-Clause like the game; art/hostiletakeover.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. HostileTakeover-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, HostileTakeover.info beside the drawer. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-HostileTakeover and COPYING.txt; Data.info is the User drawer's icon.
